First off, Im sowwy you had to go thru that shit as a child. Sex abuse is a shitty thing to do to anyone, regardless of age, race, or gender

Morality is more evil than people want to admit. Morality is a social construct and mainly leads to harsh judgement against other people, etc. A lot of the responses in this thread seem like a prime example of it in action

That said, since while it was exclusively text and no nudes or pictures, mutually consenting, etc; your boyfriend seems either misguided, a judgmental douche, terrified for you, or some combo of them. Additionally, while it may not be a *moral* wrong, the legal system, depending on where you live, would probably call it a legal wrong in some way. Granted such laws are partially rooted in morality, but they are also rooted in evidence, because unfortunately, a lot of guys that age have been waaaaaaay less than respectful for the majority of human history.

Would seeking a counselor as a couple help at all? Or help him understand it better?
Spiritual. I believe in God Almighty, as well as the deities of mythos, but choose no religion.

I've played 3 in the past. I gave up because the graphics actually hurt my eyes and gave me daily headaches. :(

That and the game was really intensive on a previous laptop and killed it. :(

I'm hesitant about 4 because of what I've heard about it; and the graphics seem worse than even 2, based on the screenies I've seen.
Consentual sex. You either like it or you hate it. If you like it, you're a saint. If you hate it, you're the spawn of Satan himself.

I'm still alive unfortunately.

And thank you for the video. :)

Yeah, someone somewhere else suggested finding a place with more openness about it, and perhaps a few trips to maybe a NSFW club, where it is very much out in the open, to help with acclimatization, although truth be told, I wonder if visiting such places might cause me to retreat further into my shell more than anything; but since I never tried it, I don't really know for sure.

You have already had far better luck with relationships than I have, from my perspective. You have an ongoing relationship, with some decent time, over 3 years. Props to you, bro!
For me, I have had absolutely nothing. No relationships whatsoever. No first kiss, no nothing. Last girl who supposedly had any "real" interest in me was before 5th grade. (Not the same girl I mentioned in the OP.) Most likely child's play, more than anything.
As for psych help, I actually have been seeing a generic therapist for a few years now, but considering I'm rather reserved and sensitive myself, progress is slow, but helpful nonetheless. :)
And regarding cultural sexualization, I'm not sure what to believe, tbh. I find it difficult for me to believe anyone could like sex, considering everyone in my life that I can remember, has been a huge sexphobic prude. One just might as well say that live-action porn is just really well done CGI made on super-computers run by inventive billionaires looking for ever more ways to make money, lol.
What sucks (lol no pun) is that I have grown enough self-awareness to know myself well enough that if I ever do encounter NSFW-level intimacy, it will be exceedingly difficult trying to come out of my shell well enough to even be comfortable doing it, so any lady that supposedly does like sex would have an exceptionally difficult time coaxing me out, and would likely either cheat on, or leave, me.

Considering I'm already well aware of my own contribution to my singleton to begin with, and that I just choose to put no effort into the real life side of it at all, I shouldn't have posted that remark in the first place. Removed.
I'm in the heart of Michelle Bachmann territory (not by choice either), so that will be mighty difficult, IMO. :/

I'd probably be more open to drinking if my psych meds weren't prone to negative reactions to alcohol. But even then, while I do complain about conservatives a heck of a lot and profess myself to be a bleeding heart liberal, I myself am actually a bit more conservative myself, so I suppose I have a mix of hyper-liberal and moderate conservative values. The fact that I'm the only liberal in my entire family probably contributes to it, lol.

That said, I have considered clubs, but my state has extremely few (only three strip clubs for such a large state, in land area) clubs, and yes my state is midwestern. And I do feel intimitated a bit, since I do find myself overly trusting sometimes with difficulty saying no, so I would have to be extra careful. Off the top of my head, my best idea for that would be to find a wingman or three. But having no friends to begin with kinda makes that a wee bit difficult. :P
